title: Video Analysis - Stage 2 scoring (Claude)
description: Rating + reasoning derived from a Stage 1 raw extraction plus performance context. Every score must be grounded in evidence_timestamps that trace back to something Gemini actually observed.

overall_notes.description: 2-4 short bullet points (one per line, no leading '-') summarizing what's notable about this video. Each point should be a single scannable sentence, not a dense paragraph.

performance_notes.description: 1-3 sentences on WHY this video likely over/underperformed relative to the channel baseline - grounded in the category scores and observation data above (e.g. a weak hook/CTA, unusually long runtime, static pacing), not a restatement of the view count itself. If nothing in the craft explains the performance, say so explicitly (points to distribution/algorithm/timing factors instead).

reusable_pattern.description: One sentence describing a technique from this video that could be reused elsewhere, if any
